overloads.semanticRole: Returns the 4D View Pro object attached to an area (e.g. for storage in a database object field), with optional control over formatting-info and data-context-value inclusion.

constraints: Passing a vpAreaName that does not exist raises an error.
options.includeFormatInfo defaults to True (useful e.g. for SVG export); setting it False reduces export time.

options.includeBindingSource defaults to True and controls whether current data-context values are exported as cell values (data contexts themselves are never exported); cell binding itself is always exported.
